description: Hyperliquid perpetual futures market data: mark and oracle price, 24h change, hourly funding rate and funding APR, open interest (coins and USD), 24h volume, max leverage. Pass coins (e.g. ['BTC','ETH','SOL']) or omit them to get the top markets by open interest. Params: coins (optional, max 50), limit (1 to 50, default 10, used without coins). Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"coins":["BTC","ETH","SOL"]}.
